❤️ ABOUT GO AHEAD ❤️

✨ Time changed everything… except their connection.✨

Ling Xiao, He Zi Qiu, and Li Jian Jian grow up together despite troubled family lives, forming a bond stronger than blood.

After high school, Ling Xiao and He Zi Qiu return to their biological families, leaving Jian Jian behind. Years later, they reunite—but the past still lingers between them.

Old wounds and unresolved emotions resurface as they try to reconnect and face what time has changed.

💔 Can their chosen family survive the pain of the past?
